current.runtime: scripts/run_policy_current.py (fail-closed until selection calibration and Development Step3 promotion)
current.development_profile_mode: Direct-TFV V2 full DEV is complete; next gate is no-retrain HOLD/action selection calibration from the frozen V2 DEV checkpoint using existing data only

hard_rules: enter current Step2 training through scripts/run_step2_current.py and explicitly select smoke or dev
primary Step2 label is same-prefix authoritative SWMM exact delta TFV
encode the complete H360 reference and candidate sequences with one shared value network and predict V(candidate)-V(reference)
Direct-TFV V2 full Development has established useful D2/D3/D4 ordering but has not established safe HOLD/action selection
do not retrain or resize the Direct-TFV V2 model merely to run selection calibration
selection calibration must split the existing D3 HOLD-reference internal holdout by rainfall group so calibration and selection audit rainfall groups are disjoint
D4 AUDIT is evaluation-only Development stress evidence and cannot enter model training, target-scale fitting, or selection-margin fitting
the selection guard may only admit the model-best candidate when predicted delta TFV plus the calibrated one-sided margin remains below HOLD zero
single-actuator branches teach per-facility main-value differences; multi-actuator branches teach only joint interaction value difference after the main stage
the 1-percent practical-effect threshold is reporting-only and cannot zero continuous training labels
Step1 reconstructed state and causal rainfall forecast are the online-equivalent Step2 inputs
do not require full hydraulic trajectory prediction before testing TFV action ordering or selection
do not use SWMM action-gradient labels
runtime/seven-strategy/D5 remain fail-closed until the selection guard is evaluated and one Development Step3 test is explicitly promoted
never use future realised rainfall, future SWMM state or future Internal trajectory online
never access Validation/Final/Formal/Policy Lock during Development
